reason: The README describes a web search and page-fetching plugin that supplies structured, sourced results to models without native web access, including optional X search and multiple external search engines.

summaries.zh: 为缺少联网能力的模型提供网页搜索、X 搜索和单页抓取，并返回带来源的结构化结果。
summaries.en: Provides web search, X search, and single-page fetching for models without native web access, returning structured results with sources.

capabilities: Performs web searches through configurable external search engines
Fetches and reads individual web pages
Searches X through a supported external engine
Uses configured API keys, browser sign-in, and network endpoints
Stores engine configuration and keys in a local configuration file
